sections.label: Parties
sections.body: Who is bound: the customer entity and ours, each with the role it plays.

sections.label: Term
sections.body: Effective 1 January 2026 for twelve months, renewing annually unless either side gives 60 days' notice.

sections.label: Commercials
sections.body: Annual fee, payment terms net 30, and the price-increase cap on renewal.

sections.label: Clauses
sections.body: Liability cap, auto-renewal and payment terms, each linked from the clause library.

sections.label: Signatures
sections.body: Signature blocks for both parties, with the signatory and their authority.
